csv_agency: US Dept Treasury Bureau Of Engraving & Printing
csv_scope_of_work: The Contractor shall develop bridging documents, consisting of conceptual design, technical specifications, and performance criteria for the complete repair of seventeen electric elevators (12 passenger and 5 freight as identified in the 2024 Elevator Assessment) replacing all components that are obsolete and/or have reached end-of-life, including MEP systems upgrades, ACM abatement, PCBs removal, structural and architectural alterations to bring the existing machine rooms and hoistways up to code. New elevator controllers shall be integrated with BEP's existing Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) system.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Design Build/Developer, Electrical Engineering

title: Design-Build for BEP Elevator Modernization
short_description: Design-build bridging documents for modernization of 17 elevators at the Bureau of Engraving and Printing.
project_scope: Preparation of bridging documents including conceptual design, technical specifications, and performance criteria for the complete repair and modernization of 17 electric elevators at the Bureau of Engraving and Printing, comprising 12 passenger elevators and 5 freight elevators. Scope includes replacement of obsolete or end-of-life components, MEP system upgrades, asbestos-containing material abatement, PCB removal, structural and architectural alterations to machine rooms and hoistways to achieve code compliance, and integration of new elevator controllers with the existing SCADA system.
services: Design-build related bridging documents; conceptual design; technical specifications; performance criteria; architecture services; electrical engineering; coordination of structural and architectural alterations; elevator modernization planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an elevator modernization project, not a bridge, long-span roof, special structure, sports venue, or complex building structure.
- Main focus is on vertical transportation systems, MEP upgrades, hazardous material removal, and code compliance.
- Structural scope appears limited to local alterations in machine rooms and hoistways.
- Tender requests architecture, design-build, and electrical engineering rather than structural engineering.
- Falls close to excluded MEP/building services type and offers very limited fit for sbp's core profile.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost stated in the source. Available scope information: modernization of 17 elevators, including replacement of obsolete components, MEP upgrades, ACM abatement, PCB removal, structural and architectural alterations, and SCADA integration. This may indicate a multi-million-dollar building systems project, but no reliable USD estimate can be derived from the provided text alone.
fee_explanation: No fee information stated in the source. The notice concerns preparation of bridging documents and related design-build procurement support, but no design fee, budget, or percentage basis is provided.
